Example: one lease clause can cost $2,974.

Some early-termination fees equal 2 months' rent; at the 2024 US median rent of $1,487, that's $1,487 x 2 = $2,974.
Since July 2024, California caps most security deposits at one month's rent; refund deadlines are 21 days in California and 30 in Texas.
New York caps late fees at $50 or 5% of rent, whichever is less.
In Dec 2025, Greystar agreed to a $24M settlement with the FTC and Colorado over alleged hidden fees; as of mid-Oct 2026, an FTC rental-fee rule was still only an advance notice (comments closed April 2026).

Sources: Census ACS 2024; Calif. Civil Code 1950.5 (AB 12); Tex. Prop. Code 92.103; NY RPL 238-a; FTC and Colorado AG (Dec 2025); FTC ANPRM (Mar 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
